name: KromiumSchemeHandler
summary: Factory utilities for creating turnkey KromiumAssetHandler instances to serve web assets from JVM classpath or local directories via custom protocols.

methods.name: fromClasspath
methods.signature: fun fromClasspath(resourcePath: String = "", classLoader: ClassLoader = KromiumSchemeHandler::class.java.classLoader, spaFallback: String? = null, defaultHeaders: Map<String, String> = emptyMap()): KromiumAssetHandler
methods.description: Creates an asset handler that streams resources bundled inside the application JAR or classpath.

parameters.name: spaFallback
parameters.description: Optional fallback file (e.g. 'index.html') served on extensionless GET routes for SPAs.

parameters.name: defaultHeaders
parameters.description: Default headers appended to every response.

methods.name: fromDirectory
methods.signature: fun fromDirectory(directory: File, spaFallback: String? = null, defaultHeaders: Map<String, String> = emptyMap()): KromiumAssetHandler
methods.description: Creates an asset handler that serves files from a local directory on disk with directory traversal protection.

parameters.name: directory
parameters.description: The local root directory containing web assets.

parameters.name: spaFallback
parameters.description: Optional fallback file name served on extensionless GET routes.

parameters.name: defaultHeaders
parameters.description: Default headers appended to every response.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a custom KromiumAssetHandler from a functional lambda.

methods.name: sanitizePath
methods.description: Sanitizes a requested URL path against directory traversal attempts. Returns null if path is malicious.
